description: Sun-shadow capture variants. MC2_SHADOW_ENABLE is the master gate (default-OFF); dynamic prop casters (MC2_SHADOW_DYNAMIC_PROP_CASTERS) is default-ON and effective only when shadows are enabled, so its kill-switch entry pairs it with the master gate. MC2_SHADOW_DEBUG_MODE=1 visualizes the screen-shadow pass classification (sky / self-shadow-handled / lit / shadowed). MC2_SHADOW_BOUNDED_NEAR_FIT tightens the light-frustum near fit. Definitions only — no captures run here.

entries.description: No shadow env. Master gate OFF -> byte-identical baseline (no shadow pass).
Sun shadows enabled (MC2_SHADOW_ENABLE=1). Dynamic prop casters default-ON. The headline 'shadows on' shot.
Shadows on, dynamic prop casters kill-switched (MC2_SHADOW_DYNAMIC_PROP_CASTERS=0). Isolates the registry-fed dynamic caster contribution vs the static/building casters.
Screen-shadow classification debug (MC2_SHADOW_DEBUG_MODE=1): sky=black, self-shadow-handled=brown, lit=green, shadowed=blue. Diagnostic-only.
Shadows on with bounded-near light-frustum fit (MC2_SHADOW_BOUNDED_NEAR_FIT=1). Tighter near plane -> denser shadow-map texel coverage near the camera.
